label: Golden and differential runs
subgoals: Fix the stimulus, seeds, tool version and command line
Compare outputs of the old and new versions cycle by cycle
Remove races before trusting a differential result

label: What the diff must prove
subgoals: Show that only the intended signals or transactions changed
Compare at transaction level when timing is meant to change
Check coverage of the changed logic before trusting the diff

label: Differential testing across simulators
subgoals: Run one design on two simulators and compare outputs
Attribute differences to races, X semantics or tool bugs
Stress ordering and X behavior when validating a simulator change
